page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What PCR is
steps.why: Copying a tiny amount of DNA many times over makes it enough to detect.
steps.memory_tip: Polymerase Chain Reaction: it copies DNA.
lines: PCR is the polymerase chain reaction. It
helps in the early diagnosis of disease.

steps.label: What it can do
steps.why: Because it multiplies the DNA present, even a trace of a virus can be found.
common_mistakes: Giving only one feature when two are asked.
steps.memory_tip: It finds very small amounts of DNA by amplifying them.
steps.margin_note: Two named uses close the answer.
lines: PCR detects very low amounts of DNA by

lines.text: It is now used to detect HIV in suspected cases

insider_note: Expand PCR in the first line. Amplification is the marked word — it is what makes early diagnosis possible.
